item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 5 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 5 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 28 August 2026(Friday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Tarlac, Bataan, Pampanga and Bulacan(Hagonoy, Calumpit, Paombong, Malolos, Pulilan, Plaridel, Guiguinto, Bulakan, Baliuag).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Nueva Ecija(Cuyapo, Nampicuan, Guimba, Licab, Zaragoza, San Antonio, Cabiao, San Isidro, Gapan, San Leonardo, Jaen, Santa Rosa, Aliaga, Quezon, Talugtug, Munoz, Cabanatuan, Talavera, Santo Domingo, Penaranda) and Bulacan(San Miguel, San Ildefonso, Angat, Balagtas, Bocaue, Bustos, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Marilao, Norzagaray, Obando, Pandi, San Rafael, Santa Maria).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Rizal, Cavite, Laguna, Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Bongabon, Carranglan, Gabaldon, General Mamerto Natividad, Laur, Llanera, Lupao, Palayan, Pantabangan, Rizal, San Jose), Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balayan, Balete, Bauan, Calaca, Calatagan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Laurel, Lemery, Lian, Lipa, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Nasugbu, San Jose, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Tingloy, Tuy) and Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Real) within the next 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
